hook: The modular curve X_1(42) needs degree 12 before it gets infinitely many rational points.

readout.label: Q-gonality of the modular curve X_1(42)

summary: The Q-gonality of X_1(42) is 12, up from a proven lower bound of 10, so 12 is the lowest degree with infinitely many points. The proof is a computer search of 743,231 Riemann-Roch spaces, cut down using a cyclic group of symmetries of order 12. An older, slower search gave the same answer. The result covers this one curve and rests on exhaustive computation.
title: The $\mathbb Q$-gonality of $X_1(42)$ is $12$
